hook: Some kid scammed my eight year old sister out of her Frost Dragon, and he picked the wrong family.
At three in the morning I joined a dead obby, and there was one other player in the server.
I won admin in my favorite Roblox game for one hour, and I broke the entire economy in about forty seconds.
My best friend's Roblox account was online at four in the morning, and he swears he was asleep.
A stranger on Roblox knew my real name, and I have never told anyone online my real name.
If you missed part one, a stranger on Roblox knew my real name, my dog's name, and what I was wearing.
A YouTuber with two million subscribers stole my Roblox game, and I got it back with one hidden room.
There's a Roblox elevator game that always skips floor thirteen, and I found out why.
For an entire month, I pretended to be terrible at Murder Mystery 2, just to get back at one guy.
I asked my grandpa for twenty dollars of Robux and accidentally created a Roblox tycoon.
My mom made a secret Roblox account to spy on me, and she got way too into it.
Every Brookhaven server I joined, someone had already copied my house.
I helped a noob in Blox Fruits, and it turned out to be the developer testing the game.
As a joke, I declared myself king of a Roblox server, and three weeks later I had an army, a newspaper, and a war.
I found my dad's Roblox account from two thousand eight, and there was a message waiting inside.
